# Shared QPE client authoring context

Informed local integration work after the shared coherent QPE and arithmetic
experiments. Read the retained QPE source, finite order-finding contract and
imaginary amplitude-estimation draft. The exact model settings are unrecorded;
this is not a controlled benchmark or a new external corpus source.

Preserve desired clients before extending the producer. Both call the same
QPE definition: order probing forwards a declared phase-fixed operation,
while amplitude estimation passes the actual Grover-iterate definition. The
first needs operation parameters through ordinary source calls; the second
also needs transparent static operation arguments with natural parameters.
Do not infer Controlled from Apply/Adjoint access. Cache instantiations by all
actual providers as well as sizes, retaining fresh independent graph checks.

The order provider is multiplication by two modulo 2^n-1 through cyclic bit
rotation, fixing the otherwise unused all-ones input. It is not general Shor
arithmetic. The finite amplitude client uses A=H P(j,d) H on the low bit,
G=A Z A† Z with its exact sign, and spectator identity on the other bits.
The state-preparation and controlled-QPE contracts must be tested on arbitrary
inputs/reference columns as well as the intended zero-prepared trial.

Use small target widths 1–4 and phase widths 2–3, never maximum-size cases.
Width four retains the existing N=15 order-finding comparison (seven wires total).
Retain zero/one probability boundaries, off-grid phases, valid wrong-sign/order
faults and malformed provider/ownership cases. Initialization, measurement to
CBits, classical reconstruction and production CLI integration are separate
remaining obligations, not satisfied by coherent branch diagnostics.
